scope: Prospective preliminary clinical research ratings; no PoS calibration or auditor attestation

phase2_link_source.assessment: Issuer identifies OCEAN-1 as the IPF cough trial of oral nalbuphine ER; the CORAL publication identifies Phase 2 NCT05964335 for that intervention and indication.

records.review_status: PRELIMINARY SOURCE-BASED ASSESSMENT — NOT INDEPENDENTLY ATTESTED

phase2_efficacy.assessment: CORAL randomized 165 patients. At 54 mg BID, objective cough frequency fell 53.4% versus 16.9% with placebo; primary P<0.001. Six-week exposure and missing-at-random assumptions limit extrapolation.

phase3_design.assessment: OCEAN-1 randomized, double-masked, placebo comparator, ~306 enrolled; primary 24-hour cough frequency at week 26 is objective, but Phase 2 evidence covers only six weeks and future attrition risks remain.

safety.assessment: Nausea, vomiting, constipation, dizziness and other tolerability signals; short Phase 2 exposure is inadequate to establish 52-week fixed-dose safety.

regulatory_alignment.assessment: Company-reported End-of-Phase-2 FDA alignment for two pivotal trials; sponsor statement says final protocols still subject to FDA review, not direct proof of approval path.

execution.assessment: OCEAN-1 initiated and ongoing with company-reported runway into 2030; enrollment and 52-week duration create material operational execution risk.

evidence_quality.assessment: Peer-reviewed randomized Phase 2b trial plus registered pivotal trial, but no Phase 3 efficacy outcome or prospective calibration.

records.clinical_caveats: Provisional human-readable analytical judgment, not a calibrated success probability. Longer treatment duration, adverse events, and company-reported regulatory alignment require independent review.

records.registry_drug: LB-102 (100 mg tablet) | LB-102 (50 mg tablet)

phase2_link_source.assessment: Issuer identifies NOVA-2 NCT07363577 as the 50/100 mg LB-102 pivotal trial following NOVA-1. The Phase 2 publication identifies NOVA-1 as NCT06179108.

records.review_status: PRELIMINARY SOURCE-BASED ASSESSMENT — NOT INDEPENDENTLY ATTESTED

phase2_efficacy.assessment: NOVA-1 randomized 359 patients. Week-4 PANSS differences versus placebo were -5.0 (95% CI -8.0 to -2.1) at 50 mg and -4.7 (-7.7 to -1.7) at 75 mg; P<0.001/P=0.002 with multiplicity control. The 100 mg analysis was nominal, with 36 patients.

phase3_design.assessment: NOVA-2 pivotal randomized quadruple-masked placebo controlled ~456 patients, Week 6 PANSS, with prior Phase 2 Week 4 efficacy; trial has no published primary outcome yet.

safety.assessment: Short-term weight and prolactin increases warrant follow-up: mean weight gain 4.3/3.3/2.9 kg at 50/75/100 mg versus 2.0 kg with placebo. Four-week exposure cannot establish long-term safety; NOVA-3 is a separate safety study.

regulatory_alignment.assessment: Issuer calls NOVA-2 pivotal and uses registrational PANSS endpoint, but no directly reviewed FDA meeting minutes or explicit protocol concurrence verified.

execution.assessment: Issuer describes NOVA-2 as ongoing and expects topline in the first half of 2027; enrollment, completion and timing remain uncertain.

evidence_quality.assessment: Peer-reviewed Phase 2 randomized results with documented NCT06179108 and NCT07363577 pivotal registry protocol; issuer-sponsored data and uncalibrated future risk.

records.clinical_caveats: Not NOVA-3 (NCT07369154), which is open-label long-term safety; distinct NCT is essential. Primary research score requires issuer release check and independent attestation.
